title: Senior Manager, Finance Systems & Operations
description:
THE COMPANY:

STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.

STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK.

THE POSITION
STACK is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Finance Systems & Operations, to lead the strategy, product ownership, governance, and continuous improvement of our enterprise finance technology ecosystem.
Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications, this role sits at the intersection of Finance, technology, data, and operations. The Senior Manager will serve as Finance’s primary technology partner and product owner, working closely with Finance, Accounting, Treasury and Tax leadership to understand priorities, shape the roadmap, and ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
This is not a traditional systems administration role. We are looking for a leader who understands how Finance operates, translates business strategy into technology priorities, and drives outcomes across ERP, planning, consolidation, treasury, reporting, analytics, integrations, and related enterprise platforms.
The ideal candidate combines finance systems expertise with product ownership, program leadership, and enough technical depth to understand architecture, integration, data flows, configuration, and solution trade-offs. This person is equally comfortable discussing business priorities with senior leaders, working through technical issues with delivery teams, and sequencing a multi-year finance transformation roadmap.
Success requires strong judgment, executive presence, organizational discipline, curiosity, and the ability to create clarity in a fast-growing, ambiguous environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Own the Finance Technology Product & Roadmap

- Serve as the product owner and strategic technology partner for Finance and Accounting.

- Own and communicate a finance systems roadmap aligned to business priorities, risk, technical health, and measurable value.

- Prioritize enhancements, projects, integrations, automation, reporting, and technical debt based on value, effort, dependencies, and sustainability.

- Shape a clear future-state vision for STACK’s finance technology ecosystem.

Lead the Finance Applications Ecosystem

- Provide governance and functional ownership across ERP, FP&A, consolidation, treasury, intercompany, tax, reporting, analytics, and related platforms.

- Maintain a holistic view of finance applications, integrations, processes, data flows, controls, and support needs.

- Partner with BSAs, developers, integration and data teams, vendors, and implementation partners to deliver scalable solutions.

- Evaluate solution trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and support ERP optimization, platform evaluations, acquisitions, integrations, and transformation initiatives.

Partner with Finance Leadership

- Build trusted relationships with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, Procurement, and executive stakeholders.

- Facilitate discussions that clarify problems, outcomes, priorities, constraints, and trade-offs.

- Communicate recommendations, roadmaps, risks, options, and status clearly to senior leaders.

- Drive alignment across competing priorities and ensure leaders have visibility into roadmap decisions, delivery health, dependencies, and change impacts.

Drive Process Improvement & Transformation

- Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve Finance processes.

- Partner with stakeholders to assess current-state processes and design scalable future-state solutions.

- Drive improvements across close, reporting, planning, forecasting, treasury, intercompany, data quality, and related Finance capabilities.

- Promote practical use of workflow, analytics, automation, and responsible AI-enabled capabilities where they improve efficiency or decision-making.

Lead Delivery & Execution

- Lead initiatives from concept through implementation with clear objectives, requirements, ownership, timelines, dependencies, and success measures.

- Coordinate cross-functional delivery across Finance, Enterprise Applications, Data, Integration, Security, Infrastructure, and external partners.

- Proactively manage risks, resource constraints, escalations, testing, UAT, release readiness, change management, training, documentation, and production transition.

- Ensure solutions deliver expected business outcomes—not just completed technical requirements.

Govern Data, Reporting & Controls

- Partner with Finance and Data teams to improve financial data quality, consistency, ownership, and governance.

- Support reliable reporting, KPIs, dashboards, and analytics for operational and executive decision-making.

- Ensure SOX, audit, security, segregation of duties, data governance, and trusted-source requirements are considered in solution design.

Manage Partners & Platform Health

- Manage finance technology vendors, implementation partners, and support providers.

- Hold partners accountable for quality, timelines, issue resolution, and agreed deliverables.

- Monitor platform capabilities, vendor roadmaps, releases, technical debt, lifecycle considerations, and recurring production issues.

- Ensure appropriate documentation, governance standards, and support models exist across the Finance application portfolio.

Lead & Influence

- Provide direction, mentoring, and subject-matter leadership to BSAs and others supporting Finance.

- Set expectations for requirements quality, analysis, delivery discipline, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

- Influence across teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and bring options and recommendations forward.

- Drive accountability for commitments, outcomes, and continuous improvement.

THE DETAILS

- Location: Denver, Colorado

- Travel: Approximately 10%

- Must be eligible to work in the United States

- Must pass comprehensive background screening

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of progressive experience in finance systems, ERP, enterprise applications, financial technology, or related technology leadership roles.

- Proven experience as a product owner, application owner, systems leader, or strategic technology partner for Finance.

- Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes, including general ledger, close, AP, AR, fixed assets, planning, budgeting, reporting, and related workflows.

- Experience across broader finance technology ecosystems such as ERP, FP&A, consolidation, treasury, intercompany, reporting, analytics, and related platforms.

- Ability to develop roadmaps, prioritize competing initiatives, and translate complex business needs into executable technology plans.

- Experience leading complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from discovery through implementation, adoption, and support transition.

- Working knowledge of integrations, data flows, application architecture, configuration concepts, controls, security, and enterprise data dependencies.

- Ability to engage credibly with Finance leaders, executives, technical teams, vendors, and implementation partners.

- Strong facilitation, communication, problem-solving, decision-making, stakeholder-management, and organizational skills.

- Experience operating within SOX-controlled or similarly regulated environments.

- Demonstrated accountability and ability to independently drive work through ambiguity, competing priorities, risks, and dependencies.

NICE TO HAVE

- NetSuite experience.

- Experience in real estate, infrastructure, construction, data centers, or another capital-intensive industry.

- Experience with finance transformation, ERP optimization, or enterprise platform modernization.

- Experience with financial data governance, analytics, Power BI, or enterprise reporting platforms.

- Experience implementing workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, or emerging technologies within Finance.

- Degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field.

- CPA, MBA, product management certification, or relevant ERP/platform certifications.

STACK is seeking an experienced Project Controls Manager to serve as a BMS & EPMS subject matter expert within the Innovation and Engineering team (I&E). The Project Controls Manager will partner with Preconstruction, Construction leadership, design teams, and OFCI vendors to establish, maintain, and govern controls requirements that support informed decision-making and successful project execution.

- Ability to review mechanical and electrical equipment submittals for compliance with controls specifications, communication requirements, factory-installed controls, interface points, gateway requirements, and project design intent.

- Ability to read, interpret, and review construction drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

- Experience with BMS and/or EPMS systems; candidates with deep expertise in either mechanical or electrical controls are encouraged to apply.

- Ability to review mechanical and electrical equipment submittals for controls-related requirements and design alignment.

- Ability to review customer specifications and work with design teams to incorporate requirements into project documentation.

The ideal candidate possesses 15+ years of mission critical data center experience, thrives in high-growth and accelerated delivery environments, can make rapid technical decisions with confidence, and has proven success managing large-scale hyperscale or colocation projects from concept through commissioning. Responsibilities are as follows:

Lead all technical aspects of OFCI electrical equipment strategy, specification development, procurement support, factory testing, integration, and deployment across multiple concurrent data center projects. Serve as STACK’s subject matter expert for mission critical electrical infrastructure systems including:

- Medium-voltage utility distribution systems

- Diesel standby generator systems

- UPS systems and battery technologies

- Switchgear and switchboards

- Transformers and busway systems

- Static transfer switches (STS)

- Power monitoring and EPMS/SCADA systems

- Grounding and bonding systems

- Concurrently maintainable and fault-tolerant electrical topologies

Provide hands-on technical leadership throughout planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, energization, and operational turnover phases.
Lead technical review, validation, and approval of engineering deliverables produced by EORs, vendors, manufacturers, and consultants to ensure compliance with STACK standards, operational reliability, scalability, and constructability requirements.
Drive rapid technical decision-making and issue resolution in support of fast-track hyperscale development schedules and aggressive project milestones.
Manage technical coordination between Development, Construction, Operations, Procurement, Commissioning, and external engineering partners to ensure seamless project execution.
Lead technical evaluation and selection of OFCI electrical equipment vendors and manufacturers, including:

- Technical bid evaluations

- Submittal reviews

- Factory witness testing (FWT)

- Equipment performance validation

- Long-lead equipment procurement strategy

Review and resolve RFIs, field issues, design clarifications, commissioning findings, and technical risks in real time to minimize schedule impacts.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Basis of Design (BOD) standards, electrical design standards, procurement specifications, and technical governance processes.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on:

- Speed-to-market execution

- Reliability and resiliency

- Constructability

- Scalability

- Operational maintainability

- Energy efficiency

- Cost optimization

Provide technical oversight for electrical infrastructure integration and energization activities during construction and commissioning.
Support operational teams with troubleshooting, root cause analysis, infrastructure upgrades, and reliability improvement initiatives across existing facilities.
Evaluate emerging electrical technologies and infrastructure solutions for applicability within hyperscale and colocation environments.
Lead and mentor internal engineering personnel while promoting accountability, technical rigor, and execution excellence.
Support portfolio-wide capital planning and long-term electrical infrastructure strategy development.
Travel to project sites, vendor factories, and operational facilities as required to support project execution and technical oversight.
Perform other duties as assigned.

- Travel: Domestic travel required up to 30-40%

- Must be eligible to work in the United States
